paragraphs.text: The Return to Ravnica Cycle is a trilogy of books set on the plane and city of Ravnica , comprising the novellas Return to Ravnica , Gatecrash , and Dragon's Maze . These three novella's are together also known as The Secretist , and were written by Doug Beyer .
Doug Beyer . (2012.) Return to Ravnica: The Secretist, Part One , Wizards of the Coast . ISBN-13 978–0786964550.
Doug Beyer . (2013.) Gatecrash: The Secretist, Part Two , Wizards of the Coast . ISBN-13 978–0786964567.
Doug Beyer . (2013.) Dragon's Maze: The Secretist, Part Three , Wizards of the Coast . ISBN-13 978–0786964574.
